card.name: Mass units after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word mg (or the g in µg, or igrams in milligrams) right after a numeric amount, usually before a slash like /kg or /L or in a dose list. Also seen once on 'created' in a lab-method sentence.

modes.label: mg after a number
modes.description: The mg unit directly follows a decimal or whole number in a dose or concentration.

modes.description: The mass unit sits before a slash in a per-weight or per-volume amount, often for arsenic limits.
